title: Missing obligation universe can mint false T4 physical completion
contract_refs: F2-WP-1200 acceptance: every mandatory obligation requires independent positive readback and counterevidence probe
F2-WP-1200 acceptance: overall host completion cannot be COMPLETE while a mandatory obligation is UNKNOWN

counterexample.setup: Create exactly one mandatory T0_CONTRACT obligation with PASS positive readback and CLEAR counterevidence probe; omit all T1-T4 obligations; evaluate TargetCompletionReport at T4_PHYSICAL.
counterexample.root_cause: TargetCompletionReport validates only the obligations supplied by the caller. It does not bind an expected obligation manifest / mandatory-obligation universe, so an omitted mandatory obligation is absent rather than represented as UNKNOWN. physical_credit then depends only on evaluated_fidelity==T4_PHYSICAL and COMPLETE over the supplied subset.

repair_boundary: Bind every completion report to an exact obligation-set/manifest identity and generation/digest.
Require the report to prove that every mandatory obligation declared by that manifest for the evaluated fidelity is represented exactly once.
Treat absent required obligation IDs as UNKNOWN, not as omission from evaluation.
Do not allow T4 physical_credit unless the exact required T4 obligation universe is complete and all mandatory obligations pass independent positive and counterevidence checks.
authority_scope: REVIEW_ONLY; no mutation authority over F2-WP-1200 canonical source/state; no runtime, physical-host, GRID10, GWT, J-Space, effect, completion or whole-system credit minted by this artifact.
next_exact_action: The active F2-WP-1200 mutation owner should reproduce the candidate test against its exact source head, repair the obligation-universe boundary, retain this counterexample as regression coverage, and only then seek bounded repository-CI acceptance.
